record.question: Why was the 19 August 2025 meeting between PM Narendra Modi and China's top diplomat Wang Yi considered important?
options: It helped ease tensions after prolonged border strain
It led to a new bilateral trade framework
It launched a joint space cooperation plan
It opened discussions on a new rail corridor
record.explanation: Answer A: It helped ease tensions after prolonged border strain. The official India–China statements in August 2025 focused on bilateral relations and resolving border issues, following prolonged strain. Reference: https://www.mea.gov.in/eam-speeches-interviews.htm. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
